company: GWAM Asia (Global Wealth and Asset Management)
industry: Financial Services - Asset Management, Wealth & Retirement Technology
role_summary: Senior technology strategy and architecture leadership role for GWAM Asia, serving as Chief Architect responsible for regional architecture governance via the Local Architecture Review Board (LARB), driving practical AI adoption, shaping shared technology capabilities across markets, and optionally overseeing Asia operations technology. Requires strong stakeholder influence across global, regional, and market teams without relying on formal authority.
must_have_requirements: University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
Strong enterprise/solution/application architecture experience spanning data, integration, cloud, and security
Proven experience leading architecture governance forums (e.g., ARB/LARB) with decision-making across risk, cost, scalability, and business value
Demonstrated practical AI adoption experience - AI application delivery, agent-based solutions, or AI-enabled workflow transformation
Knowledge of modern SDLC including AI-assisted engineering, model/agent lifecycle, responsible AI controls, testing, and production readiness
Experience building or promoting shared/reusable technology platforms and engineering standards across multiple markets or business lines
Strong senior stakeholder management and influencing skills across business, technology, risk, and global/regional teams
Experience translating global technology strategy into regional/market-level architecture roadmaps
Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth, or retirement technology domains (preferred/likely required given seniority)
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience overseeing operations technology (production stability, resilience, business continuity)
Exposure to data governance and AI-ready data architecture
Coaching/mentoring experience for architects or technology leaders
Experience working in a global matrixed organization spanning multiple Asia markets
Familiarity with regulatory expectations impacting technology in financial services across Asia markets
Experience with cloud modernization and engineering pattern standardization
soft_skills_priority: Active listening and collaboration across diverse teams

scoring_criteria.name: Enterprise/Solution Architecture Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core to the Chief Architect role - must demonstrate breadth across applications, data, integration, cloud, and security architecture.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May lack formal 'Chief Architect' title but held equivalent scope

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Governance (LARB/ARB Leadership)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role explicitly leads LARB; governance experience is a hard requirement.

scoring_criteria.name: Practical AI Adoption & Agentic/GenAI Delivery
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Heavy JD emphasis on driving AI adoption, agent-based solutions, and responsible AI governance.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidate may have AI exposure without production-scale agentic deployments

scoring_criteria.name: Modern SDLC & AI-Era Engineering Practices
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires understanding of AI-assisted engineering, model/agent lifecycle, and production readiness controls.

scoring_criteria.name: Shared Technology Services & Reusable Platform Strategy
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Driving common platforms and reducing duplication across Asia markets is a key accountability.

scoring_criteria.name: Operations Technology Oversight
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role may include oversight of Asia operations technology stability and resilience.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May be a secondary/optional scope depending on candidate background

scoring_criteria.name: Senior Stakeholder Influence & Advisory
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Success depends on influencing senior business/tech leaders across markets without direct authority.

scoring_criteria.name: Financial Services / GWAM Domain Relevance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Asset management, wealth, and retirement domain knowledge accelerates context and credibility.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidate may come from adjacent financial services or broader enterprise domains

scoring_criteria.name: Regional/Global Strategy Alignment (Asia Multi-Market)
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must translate global strategy into practical Asia market-level execution.

scoring_criteria.name: Talent Coaching & Culture Building
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role includes coaching architects and building AI-enabled ways of working across teams.

summary_focus: Position as senior architecture leader with cross-domain scope (application, data, integration, cloud, security)
Highlight architecture governance/board leadership experience explicitly
Emphasize hands-on practical AI adoption, not just AI awareness - name specific use cases/agents/tools
Show multi-market or multi-business-line platform/shared services experience
Demonstrate senior stakeholder influence across global and regional/local teams
If financial services background is limited, emphasize transferable regulated-industry or enterprise-scale architecture experience
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim 'Chief Architect' title unless explicitly held - use 'architecture leadership' or 'de facto chief architect scope' if equivalent
Do not overstate agentic AI production deployment if only pilot/PoC stage was reached - clarify maturity level
Do not imply direct operations technology ownership if role was advisory/oversight only
Do not claim Asia-specific multi-market experience if experience was single-market or global without regional nuance

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Executive, strategic, confident but grounded - demonstrate command of both architecture rigor and pragmatic AI adoption
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Frame candidate as a technology strategist and architecture governance leader who bridges global enterprise standards with regional market execution, with genuine hands-on AI adoption experience rather than theoretical AI enthusiasm
bridge_gaps_honestly: If no formal LARB/ARB chair experience, describe equivalent architecture decision authority held in prior roles
If asset management/wealth domain experience is limited, acknowledge transferable regulated financial services or complex multi-entity enterprise experience
If agentic AI production experience is limited, emphasize practical AI use case identification, governance thinking, and willingness to scale pilots responsibly
If operations technology oversight was not a core responsibility, note collaboration with ops teams on resilience and stability outcomes
